files.description: What t3term does today: the CLI commands, flags, exit codes and --json output, TUI keys, how discovery, auth, RPC, state and rendering work, and what is not done yet. It is the current command contract

The parity plan, pinned to T3 Code nightly v0.0.46-nightly.20261007.2787: the desktop's features and the order the sprint builds them in. Its yes, partial and no statuses are the baseline at that pin, not current progress. docs/sprint.md records what has merged since

The source inventory behind parity.md at the same pin: the desktop's commands, features, keys and layout, each cited to a file and line in T3 Code's source. Its statuses describe t3term at commit a244ccd
How the parity sprint runs: the audit after every ten merged sprint PRs, the merged sprint PRs with their merge commits, the maintenance PRs and each audit's outcome
Source review of T3's server and V2 wire protocol, with the protocol fixes every terminal client needs
Measured cost of the Electron app against terminal renderers, the Rust and ratatui choice, and the energy acceptance targets
How to reproduce the CPU, memory and energy measurements
